overview_description.description: PetBae is a revolutionary C2C pet care platform that puts individual pet sitters and home-based care at the forefront of its value proposition. The home-grown brand understands that pet owners desire personalized, trustworthy care for their beloved companions, which is why PetBae offers a comprehensive range of home-based, cage-free pet care solutions. With PetBae, jet-setting pet owners can select vetted pet sitters in their area, providing them with peace of mind as they embark on their summer holidays or business trips. Our platform prioritizes tailored care, cost-effectiveness, and convenience, making PetBae the ultimate solution for pet care in today's busy world. Rest assured, your pet's well-being and happiness are at the core of PetBae's mission, ensuring that every pet receives the individualized care they deserve.

product.name: Pet Boarding
product.description: Overnight pet care provided in a sitter’s home for dogs and cats when owners are away.

product.name: Pet Sitting
product.description: In-home pet care where a sitter stays at the pet owner’s home to care for pets during the owner’s absence.

product.name: Drop-In Visits
product.description: Short visits by a pet sitter to the pet owner’s home for playtime, feeding, or check-ups without overnight stay.

product.name: Pet Day Care
product.description: Daytime care for pets in a sitter’s home, providing supervision and interaction while owners are busy or away.

product.name: Dog Walking
product.description: Scheduled walks for dogs provided by vetted sitters to ensure pets get daily exercise and outdoor activity.
